latest_release.body:
The 1.0.0 release marks the first release of no code that we consider production ready. No code supports the following languages:

* Ruby 0.95+
* Python 0.9.0+ (but not Python 3)
* Haskell 1.0+
* Go r56+
* Node.js (eventually)
* TensorFlow r1.1+ (because machine learning)
* FORTRAN 1956+
* Java 1+ (enterprise edition only)
* Blockchain (everything can run on a blockchain)
